Question ID: GEO_U03_UA_Q02

MLA Standard: MLA.GEO.TRI.1

Which criterion proves congruence from three side pairs?

feedback.text: SAS uses two sides and an included angle.
ASA uses two angles and the included side.
AAA does not prove congruence.
SSS uses three corresponding side pairs.

questiontext.text:
Question ID: GEO_U03_UA_Q03

MLA Standard: MLA.GEO.TRI.3

Why can valid congruence criteria connect to rigid transformations?

answer.text: They give enough evidence to map one triangle exactly onto another.

feedback.text: Valid criteria justify exact matching by rigid motion.
Rigid transformations preserve side lengths.
Appearance is not proof.
Congruence criteria prove congruence, not only similarity.
